name: Air-Fryer Moong Dal Pakora
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) split yellow moong dal, soaked 2 hours and coarsely ground
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each cumin seeds and ajwain
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Mix the ground dal with the onion, spinach, chilli, ginger, spices and salt. The mixture should be thick, not runny.
Shape into 10 small balls or flat discs and brush lightly with oil.
Air-fry in a single layer for 12–14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
note: Dal-based pakoras are traditionally deep-fried; air frying uses a fraction of the oil.
